name: @spier/mock-ehr
description: A mock EHR FHIR server on Cloudflare Workers — serves SPiER's own population scenarios as a real FHIR read API so the embedded SMART panel can be launched against a server. Demo host only; never an interoperability claim.

scripts.verify: npm --prefix ../../web run copy-fhir && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:host-css && npm run test
